CONTAINS.definition: The source structurally contains the target.

RELATES_TO.definition: The endpoints have a nondirectional semantic link.
RELATES_TO.storage_note: One directed edge stores an undirected meaning.

EXTRACTED_FROM.definition: The source is a memory extracted from completing the target task.

rule.definition: A normative architectural or behavioral constraint.

enforcement.definition: Whether any machine actually enforces this rule. A rule that no machine checks is a note, not a rule.

source.definition: Provenance of the claim: a dated string, or {kind: owner-quote|doc|transcript|commit|derived, ref: <locator>, captured_at: <date>}. Every rule carries one; task_validate fails rules without it.

guard.definition: The wire id (from the wiring panel) that enforces this rule, or null. enforcement=ENFORCED with a null or dangling guard fails task_validate.

fact.definition: A descriptive assertion, not inherently a constraint.

task.definition: A tracked unit of work with a status. Reaches 'done' only through neurostrata_task_complete, which requires an extracted memory (Lock 2).

directory.definition: An ingested directory and structural container.

file.definition: An ingested non-Markdown file and code container.

symbol.definition: An extracted code declaration or definition.

procedure.definition: A recurring attentional prompt: a procedure the agent performs on a schedule, after a trigger, or for a bounded number of repetitions. The cognitive sibling of Episodic Buffer; if a runner daemon ever materializes, its anatomical seat is Basal Ganglia.

trigger.definition: When this procedure should fire. `every-n-sessions:N` and `every-n-days:N` carry a numeric parameter (parsed from the string). Distinct from wiring.rs `fires_on` (which is the code-level reminder enum) -- `procedure.trigger` is data-level, written by users; `fires_on` is code, in a closed registry.

remaining_fires.definition: Iteration budget. null = unbounded. Decremented on each `procedure_perform`; when 0 the procedure is spent (still surfacable, but `procedure_perform` returns `performed: false, reason: 'spent'`).

valid_to.definition: Bi-temporal TTL. Reuses the existing `valid_to` semantics from server.rs:1375-1380,1418-1423 (supersede transfers future expiry to replacement). null = no expiry.

last_performed_at.definition: Epoch of the last `procedure_perform`. null = never performed.

performance_count.definition: Total times this procedure has been performed (lifetime).

last_episodic_pointer.definition: Id of the most recent `append_log` entry produced by a `procedure_perform`. null = never performed.

extensions.custom_memory_types: Any nonempty string is accepted unchanged.
extensions.custom_relations: Not materialized; only the relations declared above are materialized.
extensions.role_enforcement: Descriptive only; no endpoint type rejection.

tool_summaries.add: Vocabulary v2: rule/fact/task; metadata governs, contained_by, related_to and extracted_from accept target-ID arrays; custom types remain valid.
tool_summaries.search: Expanded matches add bounded, directed evidence paths; RELATES_TO is undirected; memory_type 'task' is excluded unless include_tasks is true.
tool_summaries.ingest: Vocabulary v2: directory/file/markdown containers and symbols; code_ast remains the stored symbol type.
tool_summaries.memory_type: Use rule or fact; task for tracked work; procedure for a knowing-how routine that fires on a trigger or a repetition budget (perform it with neurostrata_procedure_perform); structural types are directory/file/markdown/symbol; custom types remain valid; default context.
